units.text: I automated 15 most used user flows as end-to-end tests in Playwright. I made it so a failing test blocks the release. Weekly releases run 5 months now without rollback.
We moved customer portal from our own servers to Google Cloud, lift-and-shift way. We finished the switch in 3 months without downtime.
I added request validation with Pydantic and clear error codes to partner API. I also wrote the integration guide. Partner error reports fell from 25 to 6 per month.
